title: EnvSwitch
description: Switch between Local, Staging, and Live in one click without editing URLs by hand. Same path, different domain.
longDescription: Built for developers and QA engineers who jump between environments all day. Preserve the current path and query string while switching domains instantly.
heroTag: // ONE CLICK. SAME PATH. DIFFERENT DOMAIN.
heroTagline:
Stop editing URLs by hand.
Switch between Local, Staging, and Live
without losing your place.
mockupSubtitle: The popup appears instantly when you click the extension icon. Current environment is highlighted. One click switches the tab.

features.title: PATH STAYS INTACT
features.desc: The full path, query string, and anchor are preserved on every switch so you land on the exact same page.

features.title: SMART PROTOCOL DETECTION
features.desc: localhost and IP addresses open with http:// automatically. Everything else gets https://.

features.title: MULTIPLE PROJECTS
features.desc: Manage as many projects as you need. EnvSwitch auto-detects which project matches the current tab.

features.title: TEAM EXPORT / IMPORT
features.desc: Export your full project configuration as JSON and share it with the team. Import merges without overwriting existing setups.

features.title: 100% LOCAL
features.desc: No account, no server, no tracking. Everything lives in chrome.storage.local on your machine.

features.title: MINIMAL PERMISSIONS
features.desc: Only storage, tabs, and activeTab. No host permissions, no content scripts, no background snooping.

themesSubtitle: Switch context without breaking flow. Local, Staging, and Live all keep the same route so QA and dev work stay aligned.

steps.title: INSTALL & OPEN
steps.desc: Add EnvSwitch from the Chrome Web Store and click the icon on any site you work on.

steps.title: ADD YOUR ENVIRONMENTS
steps.desc: Label the current URL, add the other domains, and save the project once.

steps.title: SWITCH INSTANTLY
steps.desc: Click any environment button and EnvSwitch navigates the tab to the same path on the selected domain.

pricingSubtitle: No subscription. No renewal. Pay once, use forever.
